captions.detailed: A wall-mounted transfer arm featuring a heavy, dark grey rectangular backplate, an angled shoulder bracket, and two tapered grey links connected by a detailed elbow knuckle. The arm terminates with a square end plate mounted on a small wrist pivot. It contains multiple mechanical details including cylindrical pivot joints, split housings, and side ribs, allowing the arm to pivot horizontally at the shoulder, bend at the elbow, and rotate at the wrist.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a wall-mounted transfer arm with a heavy rectangular backplate, an angled shoulder bracket, two tapered link segments connected by a cylindrical elbow joint, and a square end plate at the wrist, ensuring realistic mechanical details like split housings and supported pivot axes.
captions.factory: Define the wall plate using a large rectangular box with chamfered edges, and attach an extruded shoulder bracket with a horizontal cylindrical pivot hole. Construct the first and second arm links by lofting rectangular profiles to create a tapered look, adding side ribs and split-housing cylindrical knuckles at their ends. Position the joint pivots using cylinder primitives, and finish by modeling a square end plate with a central recessed cylinder on a small wrist revolute joint.
